title: Effect of Endoscopic Gastric Balloon Insertion on Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Patients With Morbid Obesity
brief_summary: To investigate the effect of weight loss by gastric balloon insertion on parameters of obstructive sleep apnea.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* morbidly obese patients with BMI \> 30
* confirmed obstructive sleep apnea with RDI \> 10/hr
* able to sign consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients undergoing weight reduction surgery
* sleep apnea other than obstructive sleep apnea
* untreated endocrine disorder
* patient refusal
